projectList.title: Transport Management Systems
details: Maintained and enhanced a client-facing Transport Management System, implementing new features, bug fixes, and improvements across existing modules.
Developed backend features using NestJS, including microservice task status monitoring and real-time alerting through Redis Pub/Sub.
Revamped existing application interfaces and layouts using Angular, and contributed to framework version upgrades.
